Presolicitation Notice/Advertisement                                                  GSA Public Buildings Service

U.S. GOVERNMENT

General Services Administration (GSA) seeks to lease the following space:

State: Nevada

City: Las Vegas

Delineated Area:

North: East on W Grand Teton Dr, South on N Aliante Pkwy, East on Clark County Rd 215 to I-15

East: I-15 to N Lamb Blvd to Las Vegas Blvd N to S Nellis Blvd

South: 159 to Clark County Rd 215 West

West: I-215 to N Shaumber Rd to W Grand Teton Dr

Minimum Sq. Ft. (ABOA): 17,633

Maximum Sq. Ft. (ABOA): 19,396

Space Type: Office

Parking Spaces (Total): 3 unsecured, reserved

Full Term: 180 months

Firm Term: 120 months

Additional Requirements:

Offered Space: 17,633 ABOA SF, of which 9,241 ABOA SF will be public-facing and must be contiguous

  • Shall not be located immediately adjacent to railroad tracks
  • Shall not be located adjacent to industrial or manufacturing zones or complexes
  • Route from primary or secondary street shall be direct and within ¼ mile of the building. Sites located on high-traffic roadway or multi-lane thoroughfare must have traffic signals within two blocks. Sites which are located directly on or near a roadway which presents a hazard will not be considered

Offered space must meet Government requirements for fire safety, accessibility, seismic, and sustainabilitystandards per the terms of the Lease. A fully serviced lease is required. Offered space shall not be in the 1-percent-annual chance floodplain (formerly referred to as 100-year floodplain).

Entities are advised to familiarize themselves with the telecommunications prohibitions outlined under Section 889 of the FY19 National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA), as implemented by the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR). For more information, visit: https://acquisition.gov/FAR-Case-2019-009/889_Part_B.

Expressions of Interest Due: NLT 4:00 PM Pacific Time, May 15, 2026

Market Survey (Estimated): TBD

Occupancy (Estimated): TBD

Send Expressions of Interest to:

Name/Title: Emily Erlenbach, DHC Real Estate Services, LLC subcontractor to Cushman & Wakefield

Email Address: Emily.erlenbach@gsa.gov

Government Contact Information

Lease Contracting Officer: Yen Banh

Broker Contractor for GSA: Emily Erlenbach & James Cassidy DHC Real Estate Services, LLC subcontractor to Cushman & Wakefield

Note: Entities not currently registered in the System for Award Management (SAM.gov) are advised to start the registration process as soon as possible.
